notes.title: Our New Co-Op Horror Game: Altarium | Wishlist Now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2524700/extras/Wishlist.png?t=1709886029[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2524700/Altarium/]Altarium On Steam[/url]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2524700/extras/en_1.png?t=1709886029[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2524700/extras/Sequence_13_4_1.gif?t=1709886029[/img]
Dr. William, who is a slave to the desire for power, sends a research team consisting of Hannah Falkenhorst, Black Jack Kane, Grimroot, and Marco Rocio to the town of Golden Horn to obtain the Korion Jewel, which gives mystical powers to its owner. It doesn't take long for the research team, who are unaware of the powers of Korion, to realize that they are trapped in Goldenhorn. The guardian of the jewel with mystical powers has no intention of sending the team back alive. 

In this exciting adventure where the roles of hunter and prey are reversed, join the team of bounty hunters and try to survive through cooperation, or direct the jewel guardian and defeat the bounty hunters. 

To win this challenge, take on the role of good or evil, take control of your destiny, and survive no matter what! 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2524700/extras/en_2.png?t=1709886029[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2524700/extras/Sequence_13_5_1.gif?t=1709886029[/img]
Determine your own fate by playing alone or with friends. Win the struggle to survive as a victim or become a terrifying villain and tear apart your prey! Altarium is a horror game that can be played solo or in co-op mode with 1-5 players. Players can control members of Team A or the Luxazul character. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2524700/extras/en_3.png?t=1709886029[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2524700/extras/Sequence_13_7.gif?t=1709886029[/img]
Determine your strategy by using all the tools necessary to survive. Succeed in the challenge by using special character abilities, teamwork, and environmental advantages. Try to get ahead in the struggle for survival with the unique abilities and special equipment of your avatar. Survive as Team A or don't let anyone escape as Luxazul!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2524700/extras/en_4.png?t=1709886029[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2524700/extras/Sequence_13_8.gif?t=1709886029[/img]
We are excited to announce that Altarium will be supported with regular updates and will constantly offer players new content. Each update will be carefully prepared with the aim of adding new excitement for you. These updates, filled with brand new content, characters, maps, and equipment, will continuously enrich your gaming experience. Based on the feedback of our community, we are striving to make the game even more interesting and provide you with more options.

notes.title: Update Notes for 8 March, 2023
notes.notes: Fixed bugs that prevented the game from continuing in some locations of the game.

notes.title: Update Notes for March 5, 2023
notes.notes: Widescreen monitors were causing the players to not be able to see the sticky note and stuck on the login page of main menu. We're now restricting the aspect ratio to 16:9 with black paddings only for the main menu to solve this problem. In-game viewport will not be affected by this change.

notes.title: Update Notes For March 01, 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
	- After looting items, apparently their collisions were still staying on the scene and blocking the player movement. That shouldn't be the case now.
	- Bugs causing "Kasparov, are we?" and "Flying Bear" achievements to not be achieved is fixed.
	- "Mr. Inspector" and "Story Unraveled" achievements are removed. It was decided to remove them during testing stage but changes weren't applied to Steam on time.
	- We realized we forgot to remove some of the debug input keys in the build that caused some of the players to have items other than lighter in their hand in the beginning of the game.
	- Some missing translations on crucial items for the story through the end of the game are fixed
	- A bug causing the music and the ambient sounds to not be unpaused when the pause menu is closed fixed
	- A bug that might cause the game to not progress if player is out of lighter gas is fixed.

Improvements:
	- We placed an item near one of the evidences to draw more attention to the area. It was more hidden than we intended to.
	- R input key added to game to refill the lighter without requiring to open inventory UI.
	- Lighter will now last longer before requiring a refill.
	- Also the lighter gas consumption will be paused when an item is being inspected to .
	- In addition to all, there are now more lighter gases throughout the game to be looted.
	- You can find a few more scary moments in the game now
	- Credits scene is now skippable. It's a precious moment for us. But we are aware that it's bit too long.
